name: import-modes-list
description: test.md import lists (branch we-import-checks): flat.w3x with 13 imports of every kind of path (make-import-modes.mjs: plain, _HD.w3mod\, _hd.w3mod\, _DE.w3mod\, _Teen.w3mod\, _teen.w3mod\, _HD.w3mod\_Teen.w3mod\, _locales\enus.w3mod\, a plain import and an _HD twin of a game path, a text file); the editor opens and saves it and keeps every entry with its flags (its Asset Manager lists them: Mode HD for _HD.w3mod\, DE for _DE.w3mod\, SD for the lower-case spellings and _locales, Teen Yes only for the game's spelling _Teen.w3mod\; docs/testing/saved-data-rules.md); Studio saves it as it is

name: import-modes-import
description: test.md import lists (branch we-import-checks): a model imported into flat.w3x by the editor's Asset Manager (F12, File > Import File Ctrl+I: no question, the file lands at war3mapImported\<name>, Mode SD, however the folder it came from is named) and by Studio's Import Manager (w3.imports.add): the same entry and flags in the saved list. Studio's eval fails when the file isn't in the project once after the import. The editor's Asset Manager is closed at the end (--close-modules): left open, the editor opens it again at its next start and it takes the next spec's keys and clicks (seen 2026-11-17: the water-off specs after it painted nothing)

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); w3.window.pickFiles = async () => ['${REPO}/target/import-modes/Rabbit.mdx']; await w3.commands.execute('w3.imports.open'); let b = null; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !b; i++) { b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.imp-editor:not([hidden]) button')].find((x) => x.textContent === 'Import files…'); if (!b) await wait(100); } if (!b) throw new Error('no Import files button'); b.click(); const imported = () => w3.workspace.files().filter((f) => /war3mapImported\/Rabbit\.mdx$/i.test(f.path.replace(/\\/g, '/'))).length; for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { if (imported()) break; await wait(100); } if (imported() !== 1) throw new Error(`the Import Manager imported ${imported()} war3mapImported\\Rabbit.mdx files after 10 s, not 1`); await wait(1000);
await w3.editors.saveAll(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
